blocker.summary: Live Codex ADG MCP serves primary checkout code, while the Redis decode/write compatibility fix exists in the eval-harness worktree.
valid_unblock_paths: Merge or apply the ADG Redis fixes from eval-harness into C:\Git\Agentic-Workflow-FRESH, then restart Codex MCP.
Relaunch Codex with AGENTIC_REPO_ROOT=C:\Git\eval-harness, then restart Codex MCP.
After live code parity is restored, delete and re-warm affected Redis keys.

routes.contract: Use adg_health first; Redis payloads are valid only after live MCP decode parity is restored.
Do not claim mem_recall_session_start compliance; local fallback must be marked DEGRADED_FALLBACK.
Do not treat rg lexical search as semantic Vector DB search.
Use native git/GitHub plugin only with explicit delta from GitKraken MCP.
Use GitHub plugin or Tavily/web only as a named substitute.
Fetch data source schema before writing; preserve property names exactly; defer Notion MCP writes during active waves.
Use equivalent plugin/docs only when exact library/version coverage is available.
Use node_repl/Browser plugin; do not claim raw browser_* MCP parity.
